source: arXiv LaTeXML HTML (https://arxiv.org/html/<id>v<n>) + arXiv Atom API metadata

criteria: Topic: LLM agents, tool use, multi-agent systems, RAG, agent memory, or agent evaluation
Mostly cs.CL / cs.AI / cs.LG / cs.MA / cs.IR (a few seminal cs.SE, cs.HC, cs.OS, cs.CR papers are included for coverage)
Full text is indexed only if arXiv serves LaTeXML HTML that parses to at least 3000 words; otherwise metadata only
Topical overlap between papers so comparison questions are answerable

chunking.boundary: never crosses a section; prefix '{title} — {section path}' is embedded
